      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RejectedToEnd</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Activity_GenerateHRNotification" name="Generate notification to HR representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotificationToHR</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Activity_CompleteHRProcedures" name="Complete vacation management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotificationToHR</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HRToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestApproved" name="Vacation request approved and processed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HRToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSubmit" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Activity_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToReview" sourceRef="Activity_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Activity_ReviewRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToDecision" sourceRef="Activity_ReviewRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Activity_ReviewRejectionReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectedToEnd" sourceRef="Activity_ReviewRejectionReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Activity_GenerateHRNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotificationToHR" sourceRef="Activity_GenerateHRNotification" targetRef="Activity_CompleteHRProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HRToEnd" sourceRef="Activity_CompleteHRProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestApproved"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says that an item is passed to a deciding person who must approve or reject it, and that a rejection returns the item to its original submitter, who then reviews it before any further step: Model the passing of the item to the deciding person as a receiving task performed by that person's role (in its lane if lanes are used). Then model a separate decision task, performed by that same person, in which the approve or reject outcome is made. Place an exclusive gateway directly after that decision task, with one labeled outgoing flow per outcome. On the rejection branch, add a return task that hands the item back to the original submitter, and connect the gateway to the submitter's review task only through that return task. Do not connect the gateway directly to the submitter's review task, and do not let a generic review task stand in for the deciding person's decision.
rules.situation: the description says that an item is passed to a deciding person who must approve or reject it, and that a rejection returns the item to its original submitter, who then reviews it before any further step

rules.instruction: When The description states that a request is first completed or registered by one actor, and only then is it passed on to another actor, who takes it up as the next step.: Model the preparatory action (the registration or completion by the first actor) as its own task in that actor's lane, placed before the handover. Model the receiving actor's uptake of the request as a separate task in that actor's lane, placed after the handover and before that actor's next described step. Do not collapse the preparatory action and the handover into one receive task, and do not drop the preparatory task.
rules.situation: The description states that a request is first completed or registered by one actor, and only then is it passed on to another actor, who takes it up as the next step.

rules.instruction: When the description says a request is first registered or submitted by one party and then forwarded so that another person receives it and must act on it: Model the registration or submission step as its own task, placed before the forwarding. Model the other person's receipt of the forwarded request as a user task (or manual task) that the next decision depends on, not as a receive task. Reserve receive tasks for steps the description presents as waiting for an incoming message.
rules.situation: the description says a request is first registered or submitted by one party and then forwarded so that another person receives it and must act on it

rules.instruction: When the description states that a role receives an item after a prior submission, registration or automatic notice, or that a role must carry out a further step after such a notice, and it names that role and the action with specific wording: Model the receipt or the follow-up step as its own user task in that role's lane, placed after the prior step and before the next decision or end event. Label the task with the receiving role and the verb and object the description uses for that action. Do not use a generic label such as 'Receive ...' or 'Complete ... procedures' that drops the role or the described action.
rules.situation: the description states that a role receives an item after a prior submission, registration or automatic notice, or that a role must carry out a further step after such a notice, and it names that role and the action with specific wording
